title: Backup
confirmReplace: I understand backup data will be added to the current system
existingDataWarning: Existing data will be kept. Data from the backup will be added to the current system. A safety backup will be created first if this system already has customers or transactions.
invalidBackup: This backup file is not valid.
versionMismatch: This backup is from a newer application version and cannot be restored.
unsupportedFormat: This backup format is not supported.
confirmRequired: Confirm that backup data should be added to the current system.
writeFailed: Could not write the backup file.
restoreFailed: Import failed. Current data was left unchanged.
pathTraversal: The backup file was rejected because it contains unsafe paths.
missingFiles: The backup file is missing required data.
integrityFailed: The backup database failed an integrity check.
zipBomb: The backup file is too large or compressed unsafely.
appVersionWarning: This backup was created with a different application version.
statisticsWarning: Backup statistics do not match the database contents.
successRestore: Backup data was added to the current system.
